## User-visible change

Explain the changed behavior and affected release or documentation surface.

## Verification

Name tests actually run, their environment, and observed results. Distinguish control tests from native execution. State any tests not performed.

## Boundaries

Identify model/runtime identity, preserved requirements, consent, privacy, and compatibility implications. For documentation, check commands against the executable and state the target release.

## Scope

List intentional exclusions and confirm that private records, model weights, and credentials are not included.
